generation.prompt: Use the man in the reference image as the exact Adrian Vale identity anchor and extend him into a reusable full-body professional reference. He is a fictional adult intelligence analyst, age 34, lean with average-to-slightly-narrow shoulders and ordinary adult proportions. Preserve his face, clean-shaven grooming, practical dark hair, thoughtful eyes, restrained analyst read, and understated thin rectangular dark-neutral professional glasses. Show him standing naturally with relaxed shoulders, feet slightly narrower than shoulder width, arms comfortably at his sides, both hands fully visible, chin neutral, and a contained analytical presence. Dress him in a matte charcoal business shirt, charcoal tailored trousers, plain black leather belt, and understated matte black dress shoes; no tie, jewelry, watch, coat, or props. Use a simple removable neutral background with polished 2D EVE espionage graphic-novel linework, semi-cel shading, and restrained shadows. Use a portrait canvas with the complete figure occupying about 60–70 percent of the height, leaving generous 12–15 percent breathing room above the hair and below the shoes.
